name: OpenThread Border Router (Home Assistant)
description: Home Assistant's OpenThread Border Router add-on as a stand-alone container, for Thread and Matter with a Docker install of Home Assistant.

envVars.description: Host serial port of the Thread radio flashed with OpenThread RCP firmware; a /dev/serial/by-id/ path survives replugging
Radio port inside the container; keep /dev/ttyRCP, or /tmp/ttyOTBR for a network-based radio
Host network interface Thread is bridged to (e.g. eth0, enp3s0, wlan0)
Serial baud rate; depends on the radio firmware
Hardware flow control (1 or 0); depends on the radio firmware
REST API port; add http://<host>:<port> in the Home Assistant OTBR integration
NAT64 so Thread devices can reach IPv4 addresses (1 or 0)
Flash or update SkyConnect/Yellow firmware at start (1 or 0)
Agent log level: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    privileged: true
    network_mode: host
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - {{env.RADIO_DEVICE}}:/dev/ttyRCP
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
{{volumes}}
{{environment}}
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-file: "3"
        max-size: "1m"
